A Aasimar battle-mage — alabaster skin lit from within by faint warm radiance, a barely-visible golden halo rimming the temples, luminous eyes with no visible pupil — a sigil-engraved breastplate buckled over white-and-silver robes, free casting-hand tracing a blazing ward-glyph mid-air while the glowing runic-blade at his hip resonates, arcs of holy energy coursing down its fuller in answer.

A Shadar-kai warlock — bone-pale ashen gaunt skin, silver pupil-less eyes, hollow cheekbones — draped in black-and-violet pact-bound robes with a fel-pact amulet of dark iron at his chest, shadow-tendrils leaking from his fingers toward a summoning circle etched in cold silver flame across the midnight-stone floor of a shadowfell-touched sanctum.

A Tabaxi hedgewitch — spotted tawny feline fur, cat muzzle, long twitching whiskers, slit-green-pupil eyes, ringed tail raised — wearing layered shawls of dyed wool hung with bone-and-crystal necklaces and herb-pouches, her clawed hands weaving a glowing amber charm-web inside a dimly lantern-lit apothecary hall lined with stoppered jars and dried herb bundles.

A Gnome necromancer — barely knee-high, enormous bulbous nose, wild violet-streaked hair, leathery dark-amber skin, big pointed ears — wearing bone-buttoned dark-grey scholar-robes with glowing-rune-stones pouched at the belt and a skull-pendant swaying at her collar, her crooked fingers summoning a pale spectral hand from a floor-bound summoning glyph inside a candlelit crypt-library.

A Fire Genasi sorceress — ember-red skin threaded with glowing magma-vein lines, flame-like hair that genuinely flickers, slitted copper eyes — wearing scorched-silk robes in amber and black with a crystal-shard harness, wild-magic aura roiling around her like a heat haze inside a volcanic-stone sanctum, her raised hands condensing raw flame into a compressed sphere of white-hot force.

A Highelf cleric — sharp ageless features, long tapered ears, irises of pale molten gold — wearing ceremonial white-and-gilt robes bound with blessed cords, a radiant holy symbol at her breast blazing as she channels a column of pure silver-white luminance toward the vaulted ceiling of a cathedral hall.

A Water-Genasi sorceress — skin the deep translucent blue of still ocean water, gill-slits along her neck, hair drifting as though submerged — wearing fluid dark-velvet robes with a crystal harness, glowing tattoos rippling across her arms as she conjures a surging sphere of enchanted water in a domed arcane chamber.

A Halfling cleric — child-height and round-faced, curly chestnut hair, big bare feet resting on consecrated stone — wearing ceremonial robes with a radiant sun-disc holy symbol at her collar, blessed cords wound about her wrists, a column of soft gold light pouring from her upraised hands onto the altar before her.

A Aasimar sorceress — alabaster skin lit softly from within, a faint silver halo shimmering at the crown of her head, luminous white-gold eyes — dark-velvet robes with a crystal harness, wild-magic aura rippling celestial light across polished marble as her outstretched arms summon a cascading wave of prismatic energy.

A Wood-Elf druid — tapered leaf-shaped ears, amber irises flecked with living green, sun-dappled warm skin — layered leaf-and-fur druid-robes under an animal-pelt cloak, her vine-bound staff ablaze with emerald light as a canopy of conjured flowering branches unfurls across the ceiling of a grand woodland-hall.

A Fire-Genasi archmage — skin threaded with ember-red veins glowing beneath warm terracotta flesh, hair rising as slow-motion flame, irises of pure combustion-orange — constellation-embroidered velvet robes with glowing-rune cuffs, a gemmed staff held aloft as a towering rotating sigil of ancient fire-script illuminates a vaulted stone chamber.

A Shadar-kai mage — gaunt bone-pale skin, silver pupil-less eyes, hollow cheeks sharpened like chiseled stone — dressed in deep-charcoal velvet mage-robes with silver constellation embroidery and glowing-rune cuffs, his fingers tracing a slow-turning phantom astrolabe of silver-black energy inside a dim arcane observatory.

A Half-Orc sorceress — green-grey skin, jutting lower tusks, heavy brow, broad jaw — robed in deep crimson velvet with a glowing crystal harness buckled over her broad shoulders; wild-magic aura crackles as she slams both fists to a stone table, raw chaotic energy splitting the air above an arcane observatory's instrument-laden balcony in shards of prismatic light.

A Gnome warlock — barely three feet tall, oversized dome of a head, wild teal-dyed hair corkscrewing in all directions, enormous hooked nose, leathery wrinkled skin, bat-like pointed ears — in black-and-violet pact-bound robes; he clutches a fel-pact amulet, eldritch violet beams lancing from his small eyes as he communes with something vast beneath the hall's foundation stone.

A Fire Genasi elementalist — ember-red skin with faintly glowing vein-lines of orange light, hair a constant drift of rising ash-tipped sparks, no brow-hair at all — in scarlet-and-charcoal elemental robes; he drives a fire-bound staff into the stone floor of the arcane hall, a ring of roaring conjured pillars of flame erupting in a perfect circle around his feet.

A Half-Orc runic-scribe — green-grey skin, jutting lower tusks worn smooth with seasons of scholarship, heavy brow, broad jaw — wearing a deep-pocketed scribe-coat, brass-rimmed spectacles perched below that prominent brow, ink-stained broad fingers; he unrolls a massive glowing scroll across a stone worktable, active runes peeling free and orbiting his head in a slow luminous ring inside the scriptorium-hall.

A Wood Elf sorceress — warm amber skin, long sharply tapered ears, ageless angular features, copper-threaded dark hair — wrapped in dark-velvet robes with a pulsing crystal harness at her chest, wild-magic aura flaring forest-gold as raw sorcerous energy erupts upward through a moss-draped elven hall of living-tree pillars.

A Dwarf elementalist — stout barrel-chested frame, ruddy bronze skin, massive iron-grey forked beard braided with copper clasps — wearing deep-earth-brown robes with stone-grey cuffs, slamming a fist to the floor as fissures of glowing amber magma-light race outward across a forge-hall's granite flagstones.

A Genasi runic-scribe — sky-blue tinted skin, drifting silver-white hair that floats as though underwater, faint gill-slits along the jaw — wearing a scribe-coat loaded with deep pockets, brass-rim spectacles fogged with arcane condensation, inscribing luminous water-script onto a hovering glass scroll in a tower library of dripping crystal shelves.

A Tiefling druid — short curling black horns, red-violet skin, slit amber eyes, a long tail tipped in a tuft of dark fur — layered leaf-and-fur druid-robes clasped with a holly-iron pin, staff bound with living thorned vines, her green-glowing hands coaxing an enormous bioluminescent flower to bloom across the hall's arched stone window.

A Halfling runic-scribe — child-height, round cheerful face, curly russet hair, enormous bare feet — swamped in a scribe-coat with deep over-stuffed pockets, brass-rim spectacles perched on a button nose, ink-stained fingers pulling glowing inscribed scrolls from a leather satchel as blazing runic equations stream across the air like burning ribbons.

A Firbolg necromancer — towering blue-grey bulk, broad bovine nose, long pointed ears, deep-set solemn eyes — bone-buttoned dark-grey scholar-robes barely reaching his shins, a skull-pendant the size of a fist, glowing rune-stones orbiting his waist as he scribes spectral formulae in the air above a sarcophagus-sized tome on the hall's central dais.

A Wood Elf battle-mage — bronze-green skin, long upswept pointed ears, sharp ageless face, coiled muscle in a lean frame — sigil-engraved leather breastplate over forest-brown robes, a runic-blade blazing green in one hand, the free casting-hand pouring a crackling arc of razor wind that shears the arcane hall's iron chandelier chain clean through.

A Dragonborn sorceress — crimson-scaled draconic head, blunt horned snout, amber reptilian eyes, clawed hands entirely scaleless on the palms — dark-velvet robes with a glowing crystal harness, wild-magic aura strobing scarlet, a wild surge of chaotic flame and ice erupting simultaneously from both outstretched clawed hands across the hall's grand mosaic floor.
